scripts.build: bun run build:go && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.ci: bun run ci:quality && bun run test:e2e
scripts.ci:quality: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run --cwd frontend test:coverage && bun run build
scripts.lint: bun run lint:eslint && bun run lint:anti-slop && bun run lint:css
scripts.test: bun run build:go && bun run --cwd backend test && bun run --cwd frontend test
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun test e2e/support/browserEvidence.bun.test.ts && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run typecheck:e2e && bun run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test:go: bun run build:go && cd backend-go && go test -race -count=1 ./... && go vet ./... && cd .. && bun test backend/src/goProcessor.bun.test.ts backend/src/localProductWriteBatch.bun.test.ts
